variable.description: (Required) The identifier of the pipeline for which you want to change notification settings.

request.description:
With the UpdatePipelineNotifications operation, you can update Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) notifications for a pipeline.

When you update notifications for a pipeline, Elastic Transcoder returns the values that you specified in the request.

variable.description: (Required) The identifier of the pipeline to update.

request.description:
The UpdatePipelineStatus operation pauses or reactivates a pipeline, so that the pipeline stops or restarts the processing of jobs.

Changing the pipeline status is useful if you want to cancel one or more jobs. You can't cancel jobs after Elastic Transcoder has started processing them; if you pause the pipeline to which you submitted the jobs, you have more time to get the job IDs for the jobs that you want to cancel, and to send a CancelJob request.

variable.description: (Required) The identifier of the pipeline that you want to delete.

request.description:
The DeletePipeline operation removes a pipeline.

You can only delete a pipeline that has never been used or that is not currently in use (doesn't contain any active jobs). If the pipeline is currently in use, DeletePipeline returns an error.

variable.description: (Required) The ID of the pipeline that you want to update.

request.description:
Use the UpdatePipeline operation to update settings for a pipeline.

When you change pipeline settings, your changes take effect immediately. Jobs that you have already submitted and that Elastic Transcoder has not started to process are affected in addition to jobs that you submit after you change settings.
